home.heroTitle: Dental implants, whitening, and cosmetic dentistry in Athens.
home.heroSubtitle: From checkups and cleanings to implants, veneers, and whitening, the clinic offers clear guidance, a calmer visit, and easy online appointment booking.
home.doctorTitle: Dr. Eleni Markou combines aesthetic detail with calm, human care.
home.doctorBody: The clinic philosophy is built around clear explanations, modern protocols, and treatment plans that respect each patient's time and comfort.
home.servicesTitle: Treatments designed for health, function, and a natural result.
home.reviewsTitle: Real patient experiences from people who felt comfortable from the first visit.
home.ctaBody: Book your appointment in a few minutes, without phone calls or waiting. You will receive confirmation with all details by email.

aboutPage.title: Meet the doctor who will plan your treatment with calm, precision, and respect.
aboutPage.intro: Dr. Eleni Markou focuses on cosmetic dentistry, implants, and preventive care, helping each patient clearly understand their options before any treatment begins.
aboutPage.credentialOne: 15+ years of experience in cosmetic and restorative dentistry
aboutPage.credentialTwo: Focus on implants, porcelain veneers, and teeth whitening
aboutPage.credentialThree: Clear explanations, a calm pace, and respect for dental anxiety
aboutPage.educationOne: Dental degree, National and Kapodistrian University of Athens
aboutPage.educationTwo: Postgraduate training in cosmetic and restorative dentistry
aboutPage.specialtyOne: Treatment planning for implants and restorations
aboutPage.specialtyTwo: Smile aesthetics, veneers, and whitening treatments
aboutPage.membershipOne: Member of dental associations and continuing education communities
aboutPage.membershipTwo: Participation in modern cosmetic dentistry seminars
aboutPage.experienceOne: Long-standing experience in complete treatment plans for adults
aboutPage.experienceTwo: Emphasis on patient comfort, clear communication, and natural results
aboutPage.philosophyBody: Before every treatment, the doctor takes time to understand your concerns, explain your options, and recommend a plan that fits your needs, schedule, and comfort.
aboutPage.careTitle: What to expect at your visit
aboutPage.careBody: You will know what is being examined, what the next steps are, and why each treatment is recommended. The experience is organized, calm, and human, so you feel safe throughout the process.

servicesPage.title: Dental services for health, aesthetics, and everyday comfort.
servicesPage.intro: Explore the clinic's main treatments, what each appointment includes, and what you can expect before booking your visit.
servicesPage.ctaTitle: Not sure which treatment you need?
servicesPage.ctaBody: Book an assessment appointment and the doctor will calmly explain your options, without pressure or rushing.

implants.title: Dental Implants
implants.body: A stable solution for replacing missing teeth, focused on function, comfort, and a natural-looking result.

whitening.title: Teeth Whitening
whitening.body: Professional smile brightening with a safe protocol and guidance for predictable results.

veneers.title: Porcelain Veneers
veneers.body: Aesthetic smile design for shape, symmetry, and color improvements with a natural, carefully planned result.

invisalign.title: Invisalign
invisalign.body: Clear aligner treatment for discreet orthodontic correction and improved bite alignment, planned around your routine.

cleaning.title: Dental Cleaning
cleaning.body: Preventive care for gum health, tartar removal, and a cleaner, fresher feeling.

contactPage.title: Visit our clinic in the heart of Athens.
contactPage.intro: Call us, send a message, or book online. Our team responds with clear guidance and respect for your time.
contactPage.mapBody: The clinic is located in central Athens, with easy access by metro, taxi, or private car.
contactPage.formBody: For questions about treatments, availability, or preparing for your visit, complete the form and we will reply as soon as possible.
contactPage.success: Your message has been sent. We will contact you soon.
contactPage.error: We could not send your message. Please try again or call us.
contactPage.responseNote: We usually reply within 24 hours on business days.
contactPage.ctaTitle: Would you like to book directly?
contactPage.ctaBody: Choose a treatment, day, and time online and receive confirmation by email.

reviews.first: An exceptionally calm experience, with clear explanations at every step.
reviews.second: The space feels clean and luxurious without becoming cold.
reviews.third: Online booking was quick and the appointment started exactly on time.
